findings.fact: Restoring an empty task backup removes confirmed proposal tasks but preserves schedule proposal status confirmed and local_schedule_created=true. Repeated confirmation returns success for the nonexistent task.
minimal_reproduction: POST assistance/proposals kind=schedule with future due_at
GET state -> tasks=[] while confirmed schedule still claims task_id=1
POST same assistance/decision confirm -> HTTP 200 confirmed, task_id=1
findings.recommendation: Reconcile or explicitly invalidate previous schedule proposal/task bindings inside restore transaction; retain audit and make repeat confirmation reflect the removed task. Add real HTTP restore regression.

resolution.result: Old confirmed schedule bindings are cancelled in the same restore transaction; historical previous_task_id never claims a current task. Repeated confirmation returns409. Restored tasks are paused and unassociated. A transaction failure rolls back task/message/memory/proposal changes and the new audit event.

reviewed_areas.basis: All ordinary new APIs require owner cookie; mutations additionally check local Host, Origin and X-Companion. Only specific WeChat bridge routes accept bridge bearer credentials. JSON identity/permission fields are rejected.

Frame keeps expected role enforcement and excludes only perception session_id from private envelope. Owner stop intentionally permits stale expected role to stop that exact old session. Manager verifies owner/role/appearance/epoch, cancellation and TTL; tracking is separate local camera scope.

reviewed_areas.result: Consistent in code and previous actual HTTP tests
reviewed_areas.basis: Declared defaults do not initialize capture. Camera absence cancels VLM camera and face tracking while preserving screen; microphone absence checks before registration and cancels ASR only; TTS and primary display remain independent.

reviewed_areas.result: No new deletion recreation path found in new operations
reviewed_areas.basis: Tracked assistance/preference operations register under mutation lock, cancel before role mutation, drain through SQLite finalization, and evict deleted stores. Preference uses SQLite mode=rw. Interrupted provider requests are not rerun after process restart.

reviewed_areas.result: No new permission grant found; restore schedule issue above remains
reviewed_areas.basis: Preference reconciliation removes forgotten/stale quote text and verifies actual confirmed memory. Model candidates cannot rewrite source statements. Per-role DB path comes from catalog. Restore imports only bounded message/fact/task fields and four profile text fields, not provider credentials or tool permissions. Asset paths come from validated manifests.

reviewed_areas.result: Bound to host layout and pinned manifest; Windows execution not proved by this review
reviewed_areas.basis: activate_tracking_addon receives fixed ROOT, never client/role path; verifies fixed manifest/files and reused base dependencies, appends imports without .pth execution, caches per process. Verification may cost startup I/O on Windows; no Windows timing claim.

lock_order_review.method: Manual reachable call-chain review; not complete formal deadlock proof
observed_edges: DISPATCH -> MODEL only nonblocking in public ingress
verified_breaks: HOST_SERVICES is released before update_devices waits on VOICE
invalidate_current_media releases HOST_SERVICES before store cancellation and VOICE locks
provider calls run outside assistance/preference SQLite transactions
finished event is set before its HOST_SERVICES bookkeeping removal
MODEL acquisition from DISPATCH in public ingress is nonblocking; role change model wait is bounded
lock_order_review.conclusion: No concrete new lock cycle reproduced or established in reviewed paths. Bounded refusal with noncooperative providers is intentional and actual HTTP tests cover recovery.

limits: No unrestricted thread interleaving exploration or whole-program lock proof
No Windows, physical camera, 5-inch display, far-field microphone or GPU execution
Synthetic providers and face engine only establish protocol/scoping tests; no semantic inference or extraction accuracy claim
Review is bound to recorded source SHA; root changes require focused recheck
full_suite_status: Existing 20-case run predates this fix; two focused restore regressions passed on recorded final SHA. Root owns the final full quality gate containing all22 HTTP tests.
